title: Entangled in the Attic
description: A dark, decaying wooden attic filled with tangled masses of thick, vein-like organic ropes and roots in shades of purple, brown and blue. Tattered deep blue velvet curtains with gold trim hang from the rafters on the left, surrounded by piles of straw and debris under a slanted wooden roof structure.
prompt: Dark surreal painting of an abandoned wooden attic interior, filled with massive chaotic tangles of thick vein-like organic tendrils and roots in purple, brown and blue tones spreading across the floor and beams. Tattered heavy blue velvet curtains with gold fringe hang on the left side, old straw and wooden planks visible, gloomy and oppressive atmosphere, detailed textures, cinematic lighting
